summary: Frontend-only validation of iteration 2 (full animated SVG overhaul). All 12 requested checks pass: site loads clean (0 console/page errors), 0 img tags and 0 stock image CSS backgrounds, all five acts present with correct data-testids, every scene is an animated SVG with the expected keyframes running in computed style, parchment contains Toran + 4 paisleys + Om + 2 lotus dividers + 3 diyas and all event details, ripple appears on river tap, CTA hrefs correct (share.google URL + google.com/calendar/render with 20260510), /audio/ambient.mp3 returns 200, audio toggle + skip-to-details clickable, no horizontal overflow at 1440/414/390.

design_issues.screen: Act 4 / Parchment on mobile (390px) after Skip-to-Details
issues: Carried over from iteration 1: the fixed dove SVG can briefly overlay a name on the parchment when user jumps to Act 4 before GSAP scrub advances the dove path. Minor/transient.

critical_code_review_comments: Invitation.jsx is ~527 lines — still readable but nearing the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting each Act into its own component as more scenes/variants are added.

Each scene component renders its own full-viewport SVG; on Act 2 the Forest scene is rendered a second time. Fine for now, but a single shared Forest backdrop with a different overlay gradient could save a little paint cost on low-end devices.
AudioToggle still silently swallows autoplay rejection — consider a subtle toast or gentle pulse on the toggle the first time user interacts to indicate playback failed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 ships full animated-SVG scenes (ForestScene, RiverScene, TempleScene, NightScene) and motifs (Mandala, Lotus, Diya, Toran, Paisley, OmSymbol). Verified computed animationName on scene descendants: Act1 has mandala-spin/tree-sway/ray-breathe/firefly-pulse/om-pulse/mist-drift, Act3-river has sun-glow/wave-flow/lotus-float/lotus-bloom/reflection-shift/reed-sway, Act3b-temple has mandala-spin/ray-breathe/om-pulse, Act5 has star-twinkle/moon-rock/cloud-drift/lantern-rise/mandala-spin; parchment runs toran-sway/flame-glow/flame-dance. Screenshots captured at /app/test_reports/{d_river,d_temple,d_parch,d_night,m390_parch}.png. One Playwright quirk: hero innerText strips margin-based word gaps so querying text_content shows 'Inthequietharmonyofnature…' — visually words are spaced correctly (see screenshot), so assert via .reveal-word spans if ever re-checking.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — implementation matches iteration 2 spec.
